text_block_list.text:
—That incident at the airport. By pouring 
our true feelings out to one another, my 
bond with Manhattan Cafe grew even 
stronger.

Gradually recovering from her despair, she 
began showing even more smiles than 
before, and then—
—Early morning, Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... From here... a 
brand new start...

Manhattan Cafe returned to the domestic 
circuit, resolving once again to aim for 
the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series.
Today's rival is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The view from the front—I won't give it 
up. Never."

—Silence Suzuka. An Umamusume boasting an 
otherworldly front-running style.

In race after race, she won without 
letting the pack even touch her shadow. A 
formidable rival running not to beat 
others, but purely to push beyond her own 
limits...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"This view... will belong to me alone. No 
one will stand before me..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —I want it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's a "friend" there... In 
front of Silence Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh, there's no one here, right? Anyone?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, moving away... doesn't make it 
disappear, then. Like a searchlight, or 
perhaps a fishing line...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, intriguing as that may be, well, 
more importantly—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold, Trainer. Look at how taut Cafe's 
body is today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heart rate and breathing are both optimal! 
Even the air surrounding you feels like 
it's bursting with energy!

I take another good look at Manhattan 
Cafe. The benefits of calling off the 
overseas expedition were clearly evident.

She reset her mindset and was able to peak 
right on time. Thanks to that, I can send 
her off to the race without any 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you to take me to that 
realm today— Yes, precisely, "Plan B"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A glimpse of it is becoming reality! Show 
me, what lies beyond the limit! Leave 
everything in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Left behind...? I won't let that happen...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The one crossing the finish line in 
first... is me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Silence Suzuka-san... She's a little 
different from what I'd heard...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I'd heard she was quiet and reserved... 
but underneath lies an unbelievable 
intensity...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(My “friend” is saying it too. “Surpass 
this person and come to me”...)
(WOOOOAAAH!)
Sparks flying even within the silence.

Guided by Silence Suzuka... will Manhattan 
Cafe be able to glimpse what lies beyond 
her limits?
